- Data accuracy (user counts, latency/cost numbers)
- Any customer-preferred wording for the quote (we used the line Tom shared in the demo notes)
- Logo usage and any brand guidelines we should follow

From: Asha Shah <asha.shah@cygnushealth.com>

Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft case study: Cygnus Health — quick review requested

Dylan —

Really appreciate you sending this over. We read through and made a few corrections and comments (attached annotated PDF). High-level: happy to proceed but please make the edits below before publishing.

1) Metrics: the active user count in the draft should be 18,400 (not 20,000) — the 20k figure was a monthly MAU projection, not the baseline.
2) Latency improvement: our internal benchmark (p90) improved ~37% on average, not 45% — please update the chart and callout.
3) Cost-per-request reduction: confirmed at 22% (your data sheet has 24%) — reconcile with our finance team before printing.
4) Quote: we prefer the shorter quote below — less product jargon: "Using Redwood, we reduced inference cost while improving response times, letting our team iterate faster on clinical workflows." (please credit to Asha Shah, VP Product)
5) Logos: we can’t allow the use of third-party partner logos on the public page. Please remove the partner logos and only use the Cygnus Health mark; legal copied here for final sign-off.

We attached the annotated draft: cygnus_case_annotated.pdf. If you need formal sign-off from procurement/legal, let us know and we can expedite.

Thanks — will look for the updated draft.

Asha
VP, Product
Cygnus Health

--
Attachments: cygnus_case_annotated.pdf (application/pdf)
